_about: Every figure here is copied from an official source (listed in sources), with the date it was checked. Change a figure only with a new source. Used by src/lib/pay-tax.ts (calculator, salary pages) and the guides.

medicare.note: The 2026–27 low-income thresholds are usually set in the May Budget, after the year starts, so we use the latest published (2025–26) thresholds.

next.change: The 15% rate falls to 14% from 1 July 2027. The other rates and thresholds stay the same.
